QuestInfo.name: The Final Augury
QuestInfo.0: Take the final Augury to Vieren.
QuestInfo.1: Take the final Augury to Vieren.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the final Augury to Vieren. It's time to use the power of the Auguries to conquer the darkness inside of you!

0.0: With the final Augury in hand, now is the time to return to Vieren.

no.0: Then again, perhaps it can wait.

0.msg: That didn't take you nearly as long as I expected.\r\n#L0##bFortunately, the warrior who had this had a strong sense of family values.#l\n#k

1.msg: That is exactly why we could trust them with the Augury. Now that we have all of them, it's time to take the fight to the darkness.
